notes:
For this first round, we start out just like most other Zenyatta builds do:

Inner Peace gives you tons of sustain (and farms Stadium Cash fast)

Weapon Power and Attack Speed amplify your baseline output — Zen doing Zen things

A little bonus armor for early survivability

The goal of Round 1 is simple: farm cash.

But don’t zone out — this is also your scouting phase.
Ask yourself:

Are you constantly getting cornered?

Is the enemy pushing into you with no space to kite?

Are you getting pressured hard and dying early?

If the answer is yes, you may need to pivot.
Be ready — because you might need to take a hard turn into Brawl Zen later in the match.

💰 Round 2 Strategy

In Round 2, the core strategy remains the same:

Stay alive

Apply Discord and Harmony

Farm cash

Play standard Zenyatta — positioning, poke, and pressure

Nothing flashy — just clean, fundamental Zen gameplay. You're still in default mode, but laying the groundwork for a possible transition.

🔧 Must-Buy Mods

🧠 Talon Mod
 • Massive DPS boost

💉 Advanced Nanobiotics
 • One of the highest raw DPS upgrades in the game, in terms of bang for your buck
 • Pairs perfectly with Inner Peace.  Every time you take damage, you attack faster

Together, Talon + Nanobiotics is mathematically the most damage you can output at this stage. These two are non-negotiable.

🛡️ Optional Upgrades (if you have cash)

⚙️ Crusader Hydraulics
 • Great early armor and damage reduction
 • If you do pivot into tank Zen later in the game, this ability will be with you all 7 
      rounds

🧥 Armored Vest + 🩹 First Aid Kit
 • Fine substitutes if you’re short on cash

Round 2 is still Zenyatta Classic, but it's also the tipping point.
If you're getting dove, pressured, or your team is collapsing — keep your pivot in mind. The monk becomes the brawler very quickly.

notes:
🧱 Round 3: The Pivot Point

This round is your first real opportunity to transition into Tank Zen, if you've been farming well and stacking cash.

🛑 TANK ZEN THRESHOLD: 24,500 CASH

To fully become Tank Zen, you must have:

Enlightenment

Golden Monk

Gloomgauntlet

Crusader Hydraulics

If you don’t have 24.5k by this round, don’t force it — stick with Default WP/AS Zen and use the optional items below to stay efficient.

🛠️ TANK ZEN BUILD (Required Items)

✨ Enlightenment
 • Converts 35% of your damage into healing on your Harmony Orb target
 • Helps sustain allies and prints cash when brawling
 • Big synergy with melee rhythm

🥋 Golden Monk
 • +5% melee damage per 50 armor
 • You now have 125 armor — that’s +10% melee

🦴 Gloomgauntlet
 • +15% melee damage
 • Heals 2.5% of max HP/sec (~10 HP/sec at this stage)
 • Sustain engine that lets you frontline without fear

Total Melee Buffs:

15% (Gloomgauntlet)

10% (Golden Monk at 125 armor)

25% (Discord Orb)
 → That’s a 50% bonus kick before armor damage scaling. Big kicks.

🧩 Default Path (If under 24.5k)

Stick with WP/AS Zen. Recommended items:

Haste Subroutine - one of my favorite items for Zen.  Makes your orbs almost be hitscan.  It will be much harder to miss.

Talon Mod - pure WP increase

Crusader Hydraulics — same thing as before.  Gives you less damage taken, which lets you stay in the fight.

This path is totally valid if you're not feeling the pressure yet — but keep an eye on how fights are playing out.

🥊 Tank Zen Playstyle Tips

You are now frontlining with your tank — no more backline squishiness

Kick constantly to:
 • Trigger Gloomgauntlet healing
 • Knockback the target to throw off aim and cooldowns
 • Maximize melee damage pressure

Fight rhythm:
 → Discord → Shoot → Kick → Shoot → Kick → Shoot… until they drop

Always be in the fray — don’t backpedal. Your value scales with uptime.

NEVER. STOP. KICKING.

🧱 Round 4: Full Tank Zen Online

By now, if you’re following this guide, you should be in full Tank Zen mode.
But remember — this build is not for everyone, or every game.
If you’re not being pressured, if you’re surviving fine, or if you're looking for poke/DPS optimization —
this is NOT the build for you.
There are better options.

But if you’re getting melted every fight, your team is feeding, or you’re the only thing keeping the frontline afloat —
you’re exactly where you need to be.

🪖 Core Upgrade: Vital-E-Tee
+100 Armor (converts 100 base HP into armor)

+10 bonus Armor

Total new armor: 235 Armor

That’s +20% melee damage from Golden Monk now.
Add in:

+15% from Gloomgauntlet

+25% from Discord Orb

You’re now swinging with +60% melee damage.

You are Jackie Chan.

🛡️ Optional Sustain Boost: Ogundimu Reduction Field
Adds +50 more armor (up to 285 armor total)

Provides damage reduction and flat healing over time

Great sustain tool that keeps you in fights longer

Also increases your Golden Monk bonus further (up to +25% melee)

If you’ve got the cash, this is your next power spike.

🥾 Playstyle Reminder

You are no longer a support. You are a melee bruiser.

Stay in melee range, cycling Discord on targets, and never stop kicking.

Melee Rhythm:
 → Discord → Shoot → Kick → Shoot → Kick → Repeat

Your self-healing, armor, and kick damage will do the rest.

🧱 Round 5: The Final Form

At this point, if you've followed the guide, you're a walking fortress with absurd sustain, massive kick damage, and the ability to anchor your team in even the sloppiest of brawls.

Now it’s time to choose your power — and finalize the build.

🧠 Round 5 Power Choices

🌪️ Instant Karma (Recommended – 90% of the time)
Heals you for 30% of all damage taken from enemies affected by Discord Orb

Synergizes perfectly with tank brawls — your Discord is always on their tank

Makes you borderline unkillable in extended melee trades

Best overall pick for sustain, safety, and value

🦶 Flying Kick (Situational)

Increases your mobility and gap close with a lunging kick

Helps you stick to backliners or slippery supports

Great if you’re not struggling to survive, but need help securing kills

Recommendation: Default to Instant Karma unless you're already unkillable and feel you need chase tools.

🧱 Required Round 5 Item: Ogundimu Reduction Field
Now a mandatory part of the core build

Grants up to 10% damage reduction

When combined with Crusader Hydraulics, gives you a full 20% DR

Also adds +50 Armor → boosts Golden Monk kick damage even further

💚 Your Sustain Snapshot (at 500+ HP / 285+ Armor)
Gloomgauntlet → ~13 HP/sec

Inner Peace → ~7.5 HP/sec

Instant Karma → ~15% of damage taken/sec from Discorded attackers

Damage Reduction → 20% flat mitigation

You're healing from everything and mitigating more than most tanks.
You are a raid boss now.

🥊 Playstyle: Brawl, Brawl, Brawl

Stick to your shoot → kick → shoot → kick rhythm

Stay in melee range

Lead pushes with your tank, disrupt the enemy backline when you can

Always be Discording, always be Kicking

The only way you die now is if you stop kicking.

🧱 Round 6: Final Form — The Raid Boss Monk

By Round 6, the build is complete.
You are no longer a support. You are no longer human.
You are a golden, armored monk of death — and there is nothing more to add.

🛡️ Final Touch: Rustung Von Wilhelm
+15 Armor

+50 Base Health

Pushes you to ~600 Total HP and 300 Armor

This pushes your Golden Monk bonus to its final tier:

+30% Melee Damage (from 300 Armor)

+15% Gloomgauntlet Melee

+25% Discord Bonus

💥 Kick Damage Math:

Base Kick: ~87

After Discord Orb: ~110 per kick

That’s three or four kicks for a squishy, around ten for a tank. And that's not counting the normal shots you mix in between kicks.
And you’re healing the whole time.

💚 Sustain Snapshot (Final Build Totals)

600 Health

300 Armor

15 HP/sec from Gloomgauntlet

7.5 HP/sec from Inner Peace

20% Damage Reduction (Crusader + Ogundimu)

15% Healing from damage taken by Discorded targets (Instant Karma)

Transcendence charges quickly — use it to reset or save your team

You are now functionally immortal in any fight you commit to correctly.

🧘 Gameplan: Transcendent Violence

Your rhythm stays the same:

Discord → Shoot → Kick → Shoot → Kick → Repeat
Never stop. Never back up. Never blink.

Brawl next to your tank

Lead dives

Punish overextensions

Eat CC and keep swinging

Use Transcendence aggressively if needed

🏁 This is it. You are complete.
There is no next upgrade.
You’ve built the strongest Zenyatta in the game for raw durability and melee burst.
From support… to sustain bruiser… to endgame raid boss.

Kick. Shoot. Kick.
And don’t stop until you drop — or the enemy does.
